project_title: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF A FOAM CUTTING 3-AXIS DEVICE

faculty_guidance.name: Dr. K. C. Bhosale
faculty_guidance.designation: Head of Department (HOD), Department of Mechanical Engineering, Sanjivani University

technical_parameters.kinematics: Cartesian 3-Axis (X: Lateral gantry, Y: Longitudinal workbed, Z: Vertical elevation)
technical_parameters.actuators: 28BYJ-48 5V Stepper Motors (Internal Gear Reduction 64:1, 4096 steps/rev half-step)
technical_parameters.drivers: ULN2003A 7-Channel Darlington Array Driver Boards with Status LEDs
technical_parameters.cutting_mechanism: Calibrated Heated Resistance Ni-Chrome Wire with Spring Tensioner
